Package com.saicone.types.util

Class WrappedList<A,​B>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.saicone.types.util.WrappedObject<A,​B>
      • com.saicone.types.util.WrappedCollection<A,​B>
        • com.saicone.types.util.WrappedList<A,​B>
  • Type Parameters:
    A - the base type of object.
    B - the type of object to represent A.
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    Iterable<B>, Collection<B>, List<B>
    public class WrappedList<A,​B>
extends WrappedCollection<A,​B>
implements List<B>
    Represents a List of type A as a List of type B.
